scope: Independent ordinary and standard-600 timing reduction for issue234; historical and earlier paired samples remain separate.
method: Python standard-library readers of retained raw JSON, without importing production reducers; Decimal median and nearest-rank p95.

limitations: Each OS/test ordinary stratum has one observation: median=p95=max, not a useful tail estimate.
Ordinary cases and import preflights remain outside the registered stress campaign N.
Runner agent downloaded extracted artifacts using gh run download; catalogue ZIP digests are retained but not independently rehashed locally.
Windows executes the retained source-qualified native build; Linux compiles native from the synthetic merge checkout.
The executed synthetic merge checkout has the same tree as the admitted PR head, but distinct commit identity.

caveats: Repetitions are clustered ten per hosted batch; serial and parallel batch indices do not pair hardware/load.
Native worker count is unchanged; three-process parallelism is a separate workload manipulation.
The candidate begins independent capture after 30 seconds without new progress and fails after 45 idle seconds; measured timeout seconds are since process start, not fixed at 45.
The 120-second whole-fixture internal guard emits a sticky ERROR; a completed process with that error is an other failure, not automatically a timeout.
The 180-second outer deadline remains; 233 used that full deadline, so timeout elapsed tails across sources are not directly comparable.
Captured debugger activity can pause the process; native snapshots support mechanism diagnosis only to the extent of actual captured frames.
Both selected Rapier bytes and native source/runtime identities differ from baseline; a historical comparison is not a same-host randomized causal estimate.
stress.hosted_distribution_comparison: Identical counts and observations; displayed median differences at most 0.001s from production float rounding versus exact Decimal median.
